async def act(page):
    # Ensure the page is fully loaded
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Find all issue links that have a 'type: bug 🐞' label
    bug_issues = []
    # Get all link elements on the page
    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    # Iterate through each link to check for bug label
    for i in range(await all_links.count()):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        # Check if this link has a child group with label 'type: bug 🐞'
        has_bug_label = await link.get_by_role('group', name='Labels').get_by_role('link', name='type: bug 🐞').count() > 0
        if has_bug_label:
            # Extract the name of the issue link (the text content)
            issue_name = await link.text_content()
            bug_issues.append(issue_name.strip())
    
    # Return the list of bug issue names
    if not bug_issues:
        return 'No opened bug issues found.'
    else:
        return '\n'.join(bug_issues)
